body_lead: Bengaluru: A 54-year-old woman from CV Raman Nagar lost over Rs 33 lakh to cybercriminals after falling for a deepfake video on Facebook that featured Union finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman promoting a fraudulent trading platform. Believing the video to be genuine, she registered on the site, shared her banking and KYC (Know Your Customer) details, and made multiple transfers before realising she had been duped. Initially, she was instructed to invest Rs 21,000. After three months, the cyber fraudsters contacted her, claiming that her trading account had generated a profit of $88,000.
